planets.name: HAT-P-13 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-13 with a 2.92-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: HAT-P-13 b was found in 2009 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HAT-P-13. Its orbit and size follow Winn et al. 2010's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname WINN_ET_AL__2010): disc_year 2009, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 2.91624121, pl_radj 1.272, pl_bmassj 0.851

quotes.title: HAT-P-13b
quotes.card: HAT-P-13b is an extrasolar planet approximately 700 light-years away in the constellation Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: The planet was discovered when it transited across its sun, HAT-P-13.
